eric-app-builder-v2 v1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the full-stack application builder skill.
- Supports detection of common app types, tech stack selection, and scaffolding for modern 2025 web projects.
- Provides detailed implementation planning and task breakdown templates.
- Includes patterns for modular project structure, feature isolation, and shared code management.
- Offers structured guidance on error handling, stepwise development, and user coordination throughout the build process.
